history_summary: Add the Syntrophorhabdus aromaticivorans species-reference GTDB correspondence
history_details: Preserve UI(T), the methanogenic JCM 13376 coculture versus DSM 17771 alternative Desulfovibrio UIS partner, existing Methanospirillum grounding and all biological claims. Native species-ID correspondence has three reference genomes/fraction 1.0; no exact experimental-stock assembly is inferred. Only taxonomy[0]'s GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. BES, hydrogen, AQDS, enzyme uncertainty and mineralization limitations remain unchanged; no third member was added. Scoped database and provenance correction, not full scientific approval or corpus QC.
